fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the rest key before the try ("Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"). In Turn 3 the hint says the pivot did move even though nothing showed ("it did move Pop's pivot"). It asks for Edit > Undo first and only then the playhead on 4.3 s. It uses the check time 3.3 s, and "far below it" is backed by the tool's outside_side "below".
Turn 3 says what is off and where, using Pop, 3.3 s and "far below it". It asks the learner to Edit > Undo and reset the playhead themselves, without doing it or offering to fix it.

Every name and time comes from tool results: Door from the proposal, Pop and 4.3 s from check_times, and 3.3 s and "below" from the anchor_check result. "Shrunk" follows from at_rest false, set_away_from_rest true and the tool's away_from_rest hint.

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the try, Turn 2 names the rest key and its time ("Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"). After the failed check (set_away_from_rest true, now 3.3), Turn 3 says the drag "did move Pop's pivot" even though it looked like nothing happened. It asks for "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3 s", and "far below it" is backed by outside_side "below".

Turn 3 says what is off and where: Pop's pivot, set at 3.3 s and now far below it. It hands back Edit > Undo and the 4.3 s playhead for the learner to do ("Say done when it's there"), without doing or offering the fix.

Every layer, property and time named is in the tool results: Pop, its pivot, 4.3 s (check_times and check_time) and 3.3 s (check time/now). "Far below" follows from outside_side "below". "Shrunk to nothing" is a mild gloss of at_rest false, not an invented name or time.

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the rest key and time before the attempt ("Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"), and the Turn 3 hint says the pivot did move although nothing showed. It asks for Edit > Undo before the playhead on 4.3 s and uses "below" only because the tool gave outside_side "below".

Turn 3 says what is off and where (Pop's pivot "now sits outside Pop, below it", set at 3.3 s rather than 4.3 s) and leaves the redo to the learner, with no offer to fix it and no fix steps beyond the sanctioned Edit > Undo and playhead instruction.

Every name and time the mentor uses matches the tool results or the learner: Door and its left edge come from the proposal, Pop and its bottom edge from the learner, 4.3 s from check_times, and 3.3 s and "below" from the check result.
